### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

[ Protect Your Apps & Networks ][138]
[Security Solutions][Security Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

[ Optimize & Scale Your Infrastructure ][139]
[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]

### Centralized Management & Automation Solutions

#### Simplify operations across complex environments

Managing infrastructure across multiple clouds is becoming increasingly complex, especially for
AI‑enabled apps that demand precise capacity planning and prompt scaling.

A10 Control provides centralized management for A10’s security and infrastructure solutions,
enabling intelligent analytics, traffic visibility, and streamlined operations across any
environment.

# Protect, Optimize, and Scale Your Infrastructure for AI

Confidently meet the demands of AI with solutions that secure and deliver your mission-critical
applications and networks

[ Explore Solutions ][137]

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

[ Protect Your Apps & Networks ][138]
[Security Solutions][Security Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

[ Optimize & Scale Your Infrastructure ][139]
[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]

### Centralized Management & Automation Solutions

#### Simplify operations across complex environments

Managing infrastructure across multiple clouds is becoming increasingly complex, especially for
AI‑enabled apps that demand precise capacity planning and prompt scaling.

A10 Control provides centralized management for A10’s security and infrastructure solutions,
enabling intelligent analytics, traffic visibility, and streamlined operations across any
environment.

[ Streamline Your IT Operations ][140]
[Centralized Management & Automation Solutions][Centralized Management & Automation Solutions]

[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]
[Centralized Management & Automation Solutions][Centralized Management & Automation Solutions]

### Why A10

## A10 delivers simplification without compromise, unifying performance, security, and operational
## efficiency at scale.

#### Industry-leading performance

Unified architecture delivers high concurrency and low latency for enterprise networks and carrier
backbones

#### Comprehensive, Integrated Security

Including unified web application and API security, DNS firewall, DDoS protection, and AI guardrails

#### Simple Operations for Predictable OPEX

With all-inclusive license and flexible scale-out across multi or hybrid clouds

#### World-class Customer Support

From a dedicated team, available 24/7/365

### Our Customers

## 7,700+ businesses trust A10 to power their critical apps, networks, and AI workloads

From Fortune 500 enterprises to service providers and government agencies, organizations worldwide
rely on A10 Networks to deliver secure, high-performance infrastructure for their most demanding
applications.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

[ Start Your Cybersecurity Journey ][93]
[ [Advertisement for an online multi-domain cybersecurity training program offering advanced
cybersecurity and management certification with a red 'Enroll Instantly' button, logos, and trainer
photos.] ][94]

**✔** CPD Accredited (170+ CPD Hours). ACE-Recognized (6 Semester College Credit Hour)
**✔** 300+ Interactive Bite-sized Lessons Covering All Major Cybersecurity Domains
**✔** Led by Janero Washington with 10+ Years of Cybersecurity Teaching Expertise
**✔** Risk-Free 14-Day Refund, Lifetime Access, Flexible Payment Plans & Mentorship
**✔** Real-World Cybersecurity Cases, Labs, Simulations, and Capstone
**✔** Preparation for Certification Exams While Gaining Career Confidence Across Roles
**✔** Fast-Track (8 Weeks) or Self-Paced (Up to 6 Months) Study Options

`Lesson Overview`

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s
[Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification][95]. You learn how to outthink,
outmaneuver, and outlast the next generation of cyber threats.
**Inside 300+ carefully crafted lessons, you’ll master:**

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

[icon]

#### Incident Response and Digital Forensics

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

[ Start Your Cybersecurity Journey ][93]
[ [Advertisement for an online multi-domain cybersecurity training program offering advanced
cybersecurity and management certification with a red 'Enroll Instantly' button, logos, and trainer
photos.] ][94]

**✔** CPD Accredited (170+ CPD Hours). ACE-Recognized (6 Semester College Credit Hour)
**✔** 300+ Interactive Bite-sized Lessons Covering All Major Cybersecurity Domains
**✔** Led by Janero Washington with 10+ Years of Cybersecurity Teaching Expertise
**✔** Risk-Free 14-Day Refund, Lifetime Access, Flexible Payment Plans & Mentorship
**✔** Real-World Cybersecurity Cases, Labs, Simulations, and Capstone
**✔** Preparation for Certification Exams While Gaining Career Confidence Across Roles
**✔** Fast-Track (8 Weeks) or Self-Paced (Up to 6 Months) Study Options

`Lesson Overview`

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s
[Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification][95]. You learn how to outthink,
outmaneuver, and outlast the next generation of cyber threats.
**Inside 300+ carefully crafted lessons, you’ll master:**

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

[icon]

#### Incident Response and Digital Forensics

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

[Information Security and Data Protection]

#### Information Security and Data Protection

Command identity management, cryptography, and GDPR/CCPA-grade data defense — the skillset every
future-ready organization demands.

[icon]

#### Malware Analysis and Reverse Engineering

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Cybersecurity in Specialized Sectors

Dominate critical sector cybersecurity: healthcare, aviation, maritime, smart cities, and more.

[icon]

#### Cloud Security and Virtual Environments

Build resilient cloud infrastructures across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments — fully compliant,
fully secure

[icon]

#### Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Foundations of Cybersecurity

Build indestructible knowledge in threat landscapes, frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and legal/ethical
operations

[icon]

#### Endpoint, Cloud, and Application Security

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless
attacks.

[icon]

#### Network Security and Infrastructure Protection

Architect, harden, and defend 5G, cloud, and enterprise networks with firewalls, IDPS, VPNs, and
Zero Trust models.

[icon]

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning
enhanced threat hunting.

portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.

  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

[ ➔ Get Started ][97]

`how it works`

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

# Welcome, Binisoft fans

  # [Windows Firewall Control][7]
  
  Windows Firewall Control is a powerful tool which extends the functionality of Windows Firewall
  and provides quick access to the most frequent options of the Windows Firewall. It runs in the
  system tray and allows user to control the native firewall easily without having to waste time by
  navigating to the specific part of the firewall.
* [USBC icon]
  
  # [USB Flash Drives Control][8]
  
  USB Flash Drives Control is a small and easy to use utility that runs in system tray, next to the
  system clock, and provides quick access to control the way in which USB flash drives are used on
  your computer. This tool offers access to few, but powerful, options that help you control how
  your USB removable drives are used.

REESE'S Ingredient Downgrades

[REESE’S THiNS][15] is a materially downgraded product because the Milk Chocolate has been replaced
by a "Chocolate Candy" compound coating that melts waxy, tastes flat and leaves a greasy film,
padded with lactose, milk fat, PGPR and dextrose. The interior peanut‑butter system is diluted with
added sugar and fillers until the peanut profile collapses into a thin, overly sweet paste. The
result is a chalky, greasy, off note bite, a far cry from the tight, short list architecture and
clean melt of a real REESE’S Peanut Butter Cup.

[[REESE'S Peanut Butter Cups THiNS Chocolate Candy]][16]

[REESE’S Minis Unwrapped][17] collapse on taste because they’re built on a multi‑oil "Chocolate
Candy" compound, a waxy, greasy coating that melts wrong, coats the palate and leaves a flat, sugary
after film paired with a peanut‑butter‑crème filling bulked out with lactose, whey, dextrose and
stabilizers that dilute the peanut flavor into something thin, chalky and overly sweet. It eats
nothing like a real REESE’S Peanut Butter Cup.

[[REESE'S Peanut Butter Cups THiNS Chocolate Candy]][18]

# [BRAD REESE][10]

Growing REESE'S Worldwide One Peanut Butter Cup at a Time, grandson of H. B. REESE (Inventor of
REESE'S).
Vintage REESE'S Advertisement
[[Vintage 1933 H. B. Reese Candy Company advertisement featuring Mr. and Mrs. H. B. Reese and their
fourteen children]][11]
[Vintage 1933 REESE'S Advertisement][12]
Vintage Reese Plant Photo
[[Vintage 1957 Opening Day of the new H. B. Reese Candy Company Plant, Hershey, PA]][13]
[Vintage 1957 Opening Day of the new H. B. Reese Candy Company Plant, Hershey, PA][14]
Media

Saturday Night Live (SNL) Weekend Update: 1,509,688 views, 21,540 likes and 420 comments.

CNN Laura Coates Live with Victor Blackwell.

Good Morning America (GMA) with Will Reeve.

MrBeast taste tests FEASTABLES Peanut Butter Cups with Brad Reese: 31,137,159 views, 1,002,265 likes
and 8,482 comments.

The Late Show with Stephen Colbert talks about Brad Reese at the 9:25 minute time mark: 3,190,560
views, 97,262 likes and 5,966 comments.

REESE'S Ingredient Downgrades

[REESE’S THiNS][15] is a materially downgraded product because the Milk Chocolate has been replaced
by a "Chocolate Candy" compound coating that melts waxy, tastes flat and leaves a greasy film,
padded with lactose, milk fat, PGPR and dextrose. The interior peanut‑butter system is diluted with
added sugar and fillers until the peanut profile collapses into a thin, overly sweet paste. The
result is a chalky, greasy, off note bite, a far cry from the tight, short list architecture and
clean melt of a real REESE’S Peanut Butter Cup.

[[REESE'S Peanut Butter Cups THiNS Chocolate Candy]][16]

[REESE’S Minis Unwrapped][17] collapse on taste because they’re built on a multi‑oil "Chocolate
Candy" compound, a waxy, greasy coating that melts wrong, coats the palate and leaves a flat, sugary
after film paired with a peanut‑butter‑crème filling bulked out with lactose, whey, dextrose and
stabilizers that dilute the peanut flavor into something thin, chalky and overly sweet. It eats
nothing like a real REESE’S Peanut Butter Cup.

[[REESE'S Peanut Butter Cups THiNS Chocolate Candy]][18]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

# At ControlSoft Canada, we provide custom solutions to our clients Automation hardware and software

Our Team of hardware and software engineers have expertise in finding solutions for new and existing
legacy automation system upgrades. We share and provide our deep knowledge in electrical controls
design, automation controls software and SCADA systems.

ControlSoft Canada provides full system development life cycle including control panel upgrades,
modernization with the latest PLC design and software, system integration, and support for MES
integration, along with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) solutions including PLC
control system design and programming for manufacturing plants and industrial facilities.

# ADVANCE THE WORLD,
# ONE JOURNEY AT A TIME.

Moving Forward
[ View in Spanish ][51]

Since day one, we’ve been inspired by a bold idea — creating better experiences for how the world
moves.

[Aerial view of a highway interchange with cars moving on and off the ramps.]

For more than 65 years we’ve been moving mobility forward. As mobility has evolved, so have we. And
we’re not standing still. As we look to the future, our vision is clear. We want to be the world’s
best and most trusted mobility company.

Enterprise Mobility^{TM} marks the beginning of our next chapter, reinforcing our commitment to
deliver exceptional service for partners, customers and neighbors – innovating with intention to
meet their ever-changing needs.

While our corporate brand is changing, who we are is not. Our enduring values continue to guide
every interaction with our customers, partners, communities and each other.

We’ve always been a people-first, purpose-led organization. As Enterprise Mobility, we’re
reaffirming our dedication to every journey and every person through people-first mobility
experiences.

## Moving Forward

You know us for our rental brands, but that’s just the beginning of what we do.
[ [Brand services.] ][52]

### Services

### & Stories

#### What drives us

[A group of smiling people holding shovels and rakes standing in a sunny field.]

Staying true to our values in how we do business and giving back to our communities.



[Two smiling men shaking hands next to a minivan in a car sales lot.]

Maintaining our culture of exceptional service that always puts people first.

[A white electric vehicle plugged into a charging station.]

Innovating with intention to meet the needs of the people we serve.

[A smiling woman sitting behind a counter with an open laptop in front of her.]

Creating meaningful connections across our global network.

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

****AI Agent-Powered TDIR****

Automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR). An integrated team of

evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

[target]

****Insider Threat Coverage for Humans and Agents****

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

[outcomes]

****Quantifiable, Outcomes-Focused Security****

Benchmark and prove the value of your security program against peers and measurable outcomes.
Translate raw security data into business-relevant insights to demonstrate progress against your
most strategic use cases, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and compliance initiatives.

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

# Web Presence Management Services

## What is Web Presence Management?

Web presence management is the coordinated alignment of all online marketing channels  to project a
unified brand image. It helps you improve the visibility of your brand, products, and services
across various media, devices, and channels on the internet.

Done right, web presence management helps you not just grow your market share, but also grow the
entire market footprint. It creates new engagement avenues and conversations with your target
audience.

Web presence management begins with your brand identity, logo and brand personality online. It also
includes how your website communicates, your mobile presence — whether it is mobile web or apps —
integrated marketing through every online marketing channel including SEO, social media, paid
acquisition, email marketing and more. It also includes understanding and analyzing the experience
of your target audience, the way they perceive your brand and how they engage with you. This helps
you make sure that your brand interacts with your audience in a way that would resonate most with
them.

## What does web presence management include?
* Consistent brand identity management across touchpoints.
* User-friendly web design and development that puts the customer needs first.
* Mobile presence management through mobile web, apps and more.
* Search engine optimization.
* App store optimization.
* Local search optimization.
* Social media management and marketing.
* Reputation management.
* Paid acquisition through PPC, affiliate marketing and more.
* Email marketing and drip marketing.
* Blogging and thought leadership content marketing.

Through web presence management, you ensure that your target audience gets a consistent brand
experience and gives your content multiple touchpointsacross the web. This maximizes your business
potential online.

Flying Cow Design offers end-to-end web presence management services. Browse through our range of
services below or talk to us to maximize the online business potential of your company.

# Web Presence Management Services

## What is Web Presence Management?

Web presence management is the coordinated alignment of all online marketing channels  to project a
unified brand image. It helps you improve the visibility of your brand, products, and services
across various media, devices, and channels on the internet.

Done right, web presence management helps you not just grow your market share, but also grow the
entire market footprint. It creates new engagement avenues and conversations with your target
audience.

Web presence management begins with your brand identity, logo and brand personality online. It also
includes how your website communicates, your mobile presence — whether it is mobile web or apps —
integrated marketing through every online marketing channel including SEO, social media, paid
acquisition, email marketing and more. It also includes understanding and analyzing the experience
of your target audience, the way they perceive your brand and how they engage with you. This helps
you make sure that your brand interacts with your audience in a way that would resonate most with
them.

## What does web presence management include?
* Consistent brand identity management across touchpoints.
* User-friendly web design and development that puts the customer needs first.
* Mobile presence management through mobile web, apps and more.
* Search engine optimization.
* App store optimization.
* Local search optimization.
* Social media management and marketing.
* Reputation management.
* Paid acquisition through PPC, affiliate marketing and more.
* Email marketing and drip marketing.
* Blogging and thought leadership content marketing.

Through web presence management, you ensure that your target audience gets a consistent brand
experience and gives your content multiple touchpointsacross the web. This maximizes your business
potential online.

Flying Cow Design offers end-to-end web presence management services. Browse through our range of
services below or talk to us to maximize the online business potential of your company.

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.

  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

# WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS THAT POWER GROWTH

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

[FIND A JOB][37] [EXPLORE GDH STAFFING SOLUTIONS][38]

## Find great jobs across the private and government sectors.

Discover the many reasons to make GDH your career partner. We care about people. We will take you as
far as your professional ambitions reach.

Search

## IT Staffing and Professional Services

### Every hiring initiative has its challenges. GDH has a workforce solution to meet your every
### hiring need:

## [Technology Staffing Solutions **›**][39]

Grow your technology team with expert IT staffing services.

## [Custom Staffing **›**][40]

Engage non-technical talent with custom staffing solutions.

## [Professional Services ****›****][41]

Build top-notch teams to plan, lead, and execute mission-critical business initiatives.

## [RPO **›**][42]

Optimize hiring resources and results with recruitment process outsourcing (RPO).

## **Technology Expertise That Drives Business Outcomes**

GDH helps organizations solve today’s most critical technology challenges through specialized talent
and professional services across:
* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Data Engineering & Analytics
* Cybersecurity & Risk Management
* Cloud Transformation
* Application Development & Modernization
* DevOps & Platform Engineering
* Network & Infrastructure Services
* Digital Transformation

## THE EXTRA MILE?

## THATS WHERE GDH LIVES.

“GDH has exceeded my team’s expectations and is always a phone call away when questions arise.
Several of the resources GDH provided for my last project are now full-time team members in my
organization. GDH will be my first choice when my next project arises.”

– CHRO, MULTINATIONAL FOOD INDUSTRY LEADER

### **Need to quickly fill contract technology jobs?**

[EXPLORE IT STAFFING][43]

### **Want scalable services customized to your business?**

[EXPLORE CUSTOM][44]

### **Looking to elevate recruitment capabilities and results?**

[EXPLORE RPO][45]

### **Need skilled specialists to support or lead key projects?**

[EXPLORE PROJECT SOLUTIONS][46]

## “Best of” Winner and Trusted Partner to the Fortune 500

[Read our case studies][47] and discover what makes us an annual “Best of Staffing” winner and
Fortune 500 recruiting solutions partner.

## WE CARE ABOUT PEOPLE

Right from the start with GDH you will notice a difference. We’re a company driven by care. Genuine
care for our clients’ businesses and goals. Enthusiastic care for the career and life journeys of
our consultants and employees. Care to us is so much more than a nice idea. It’s fundamental to who
we are and our competitive advantage.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT GDH][48]

## WHAT OUR CLIENTS & CLIENT FACING EMPLOYEES (CFE’S) SAY
* > “GDH does a great job at supporting us… GDH is proactive, responsive, and takes the time to
  > fully understand our requirements and knows our culture and strives to find candidates that meet
  > our needs.”
  
  Large Banking Institute
* > “I have had very good luck with GDH quickly providing several candidates. I have also had very
  > good luck with those who were hired. GDH is my favorite of the talent agencies I work with.”
  
  International Energy Manufacturer
* > “GDH found me a role in a department that aligned with my careeer goals and offered a highly
  > competitive salary. Having the support of awesome people at GDH has been a life saver in my
  > career.”
  
  CFE Placed by GDH
* > “I am incredibly thankful to GDH for their consistent support and encouragement throughout the
  > onboarding process. From interview preparation to finalizing documents answering all my
  > questions, the team was always helpful and responsive. Their professionalism and genuine care
  > truly stood out.”
  
  CFE Placed at a Global Telecommunications Company

GDH is a workforce solutions provider committed to always giving and delivering more.
Better talent. More client and consultant support. Greater service. World-class outcomes.

### Built and run by humans

Malwarebytes offers **24/7 human support**, a **60-day money-back guarantee**, and expert guidance
and **tailored security assessments**.

[Illustration of a person smiling and waving standing in the palm of a large hand holding them up]

#### We’re here to help

Scams, viruses, and all manner of online scaries can happen to any of us. The team at Malwarebytes
works every day to engineer the best security on the market, and make it easy to use and understand.
We know how important your security is, because it’s important to our families too.

### Meet some of the cybersecurity nerds securing your world
* [Malwarebytes Employee Nilay]
  
  ## Nilay
  
  ### Site Reliability Engineer
  
  “You can’t be excited to go back to work after a vacation unless you have colleagues you enjoy
  working with and learning from—people who are good at what they do and happy to share that with
  you. I’m grateful to have those people at Malwarebytes.”
* [Malwarebytes CEO Marcin]
  
  ## Marcin
  
  ### Founder and CEO
  
  Marcin founded Malwarebytes in 2004 after accidentally downloading malware on his family computer.
  What began as a personal solution has grown into a global mission: protecting people everywhere
  from online threats.
* [Malwarebytes Employee Pieter]
  
  ## Pieter
  
  ### Malware Intelligence Researcher
  
  “I’m truly grateful for the opportunity to earn a living doing what I love most: helping people
  stay safe from scammers and cybercriminals.
  Knowing that my work protects and educates readers about online dangers is the best reward of
  all.”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Uriya]
  
  ## Uriya
  
  ### Mobile Product Lead
  
  “I’m passionate about making REAL people—friends, family, everyday users—safer online. Everyone
  deserves protection, and it should come in a way that’s simple, effective, and speaks their
  language. The best security is the kind people actually use and understand.”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Arpy]
  
  ## Arpy
  
  ### Senior Product Manager
  
  “What makes me tick as a product person is the personal touch – treating our users like the
  rockstars they truly are! I’m a big believer in bringing a sprinkle of empathy and a dash of humor
  to every interaction. It’s not just about solving problems – it’s about having a blast while we do
  it!”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Ashley]
  
  ## Ashley
  
  ### Public Relations
  
  “At the end of the day, my work is all about helping people—protecting their hard-earned money,
  securing their cherished family photos and videos, and ensuring they don;t fall victim to scams. I
  love making a real difference through empathy, compassion, and education, rather than by spreading
  fear or uncertainty.”
* [Malwarebytes Employee Russell]
  
  ## Russ

  “The minute I walked in the building for my first interview, I could feel something was different.
  Relaxed but serious. While I wasn’t entirely sure what was going on, I knew I wanted to be a part

* [Malwarebytes Employee Laura]

## The NETSCOUT Difference is Smart Data

The NETSCOUT Data Platform captures every interaction, every transaction, and every experience
driving your business in real time, at wire speed, and with high fidelity to produce Smart Data.
Rather than sampled metrics or synthetic data, Smart Data is structured, enriched, AI-ready metadata
that captures exactly how your services, applications, and users are performing in context and at
enterprise and carrier scale. Not sampled. Not inferred. Observed.

This is the data foundation that powers everything from NETSCOUT's own observability and
cybersecurity applications to your broader AIOps and partner ecosystem. One source of truth,
generated once at the network layer and consumable everywhere you need it.

## The NETSCOUT Difference is Smart Data

The NETSCOUT Data Platform captures every interaction, every transaction, and every experience
driving your business in real time, at wire speed, and with high fidelity to produce Smart Data.
Rather than sampled metrics or synthetic data, Smart Data is structured, enriched, AI-ready metadata
that captures exactly how your services, applications, and users are performing in context and at
enterprise and carrier scale. Not sampled. Not inferred. Observed.

This is the data foundation that powers everything from NETSCOUT's own observability and
cybersecurity applications to your broader AIOps and partner ecosystem. One source of truth,
generated once at the network layer and consumable everywhere you need it.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

## Digital advertising, AdTech, MarTech, and digital platforms are too complex for current market
## intelligence tools.

The ecosystems behind digital platforms change constantly: vendors reposition, categories blur, and
critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

### Signal vs Noise

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

### No Flat Databases

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

What are the different types of VPNs? +
[VPNs come in several types][111] based on how they connect and protect users. A **personal VPN**
secures individual browsing and online activity through encrypted tunnels, while a **remote access
VPN** allows users to connect safely to a private network from any location. A **business VPN**
links multiple offices or networks together for secure communication between them, ensuring data
stays protected across branches.
A **mobile VPN** maintains a stable, encrypted connection even as the user moves between networks,
preventing session drops or data leaks, whereas a **browser-based VPN** runs directly inside your
browser to protect only web traffic instead of the entire device, offering a lightweight privacy
option for quick, everyday use.
Are VPNs legal? +
Yes, [VPNs are legal][112] in most countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom,
Canada, and Australia. They’re widely used by individuals and businesses to secure communications,
access region-locked content, and reduce online tracking.
However, a few countries with heavy censorship like China, North Korea, and Iran regulate or ban VPN
usage. Using a VPN for legitimate purposes such as privacy and security is completely lawful almost
everywhere.
Do VPNs slow down internet speed? +
A VPN can cause a slight drop in speed because your data travels through an encrypted tunnel to a
remote server before reaching the internet. However, premium VPNs like PureVPN use optimized servers
and advanced protocols to maintain stable performance.
In many cases, users actually experience smoother browsing or streaming when their ISP throttling is
bypassed through a VPN connection. The key is choosing the right server location for what you’re
doing, such as streaming or gaming.
What protocols does PureVPN use? +
PureVPN supports [multiple protocols,][113] including WireGuard, OpenVPN, IKEv2, and SSTP. WireGuard
offers the best mix of speed and security, making it ideal for everyday use. OpenVPN is time-tested
and highly configurable, perfect for advanced users and businesses.
IKEv2 provides strong encryption with seamless reconnections, making it great for mobile users who
switch networks. Each protocol is available across PureVPN’s apps, giving you flexibility based on
your device and usage needs.
How much does a VPN cost? +
Monthly plans usually range between $10 to $13, while longer subscriptions bring the cost down to as
low as $2 to $4 per month. Premium VPNs tend to cost more than free ones, but they deliver better
speed, stronger encryption, and reliable privacy protections that make the extra cost worth it.
What factors affect VPN pricing? +
[Several factors influence VPN pricing,][114] such as subscription length, server coverage, and

such as [ Dark Web Monitoring,][115] Tracker Blocking, or [ Password Managers,][116] which can
affect the overall price.
Add-ons like [ Dedicated IPs,][117] [ Port Forwarding,][118] or [ Residential Networks,][119] also
come with an extra cost since they require exclusive resources and specialized infrastructure.
Can I save money on VPNs? +

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

## Preemptive exposure management with RedSeal

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting the world.

global disruptors.

DoD Customer

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises

### Find Similar Sites Instantly — Discover Alternatives to Any Website



Looking for websites like the one you're browsing? **sitelike.org** is an easy to use similar sites
finder and similar website finder tool designed to help you discover websites that are similar,
related, or alternative to any site on the web.

Whether you're researching new content ideas, analyzing competitors, or exploring websites in your
niche, **sitelike.org** makes it simple. Just enter a website, and our advanced algorithm instantly
finds **similar sites** based on keyword relevance, shared topics, audience overlap, and web
popularity.

Our system uses real-time data from multiple trusted sources, combined with smart content analysis,
to suggest the most relevant alternative websites. Each result is manually reviewed by our team for
accuracy and updated daily to ensure fresh, reliable suggestions.

Whether you want to:
* Find competitors' websites
* Discover alternatives to your favorite sites
* Generate new content ideas for your own blog or business
* Explore websites by niche or interest

**sitelike.org** helps you uncover the web’s best alternatives — free, fast, and easy.

Join thousands of users who rely on **sitelike.org** to explore similar websites, analyze market
trends, and stay ahead of the competition.

World's No. 1 Firewall

### ZoneAlarm is proud to be the world’s first personal firewall ever created for home PCs, and one
### of the most powerful applications of its kind.

#### What we do

We make your PC invisible to hackers by blocking even the most recent, sophisticated attack methods
that bypass traditional security suites.

Our two-way firewall protects your device from inbound & outbound attacks, blocking intruders at the
front door and even catching them on their way out.

Powerful Antivirus

### Millions of users worldwide trust our powerful antivirus software. After all, free antivirus is
### simply not enough. You need real protection!

#### What we do

We shield your PC from newly discovered viruses, spyware, Trojans and worms with the most advanced
real-time antivirus and anti-spyware.

until you pay the ransom fee.

We use Check Point’s award-winning technology to encrypt your sensitive data and never-before-seen
ransomware infections, all the while restoring your files.

##### Found in these products

Mobile Security

### We secure your mobile digital life with the essential protection that free traditional solutions
### don’t provide.

#### What we do

We enable you to shop, bank, check emails, and post on social media with the knowledge that you’re
secure at every moment.

#### How we do it

We protect your device when it connects to Wi-Fi networks, and block attempts to remotely seize
control of your camera and mic. You’re immediately notified about malicious apps, including
ransomware.
